title: Tool error
description: Why a tool call failed, as fields rather than prose, so a consumer routes on kind instead of parsing a message.

kind.description: Coarse class, for routing and display. The agent uses: not_found, denied, timeout, canceled, exit_status, invalid_argument, internal. Open by design: a new class is a new string, not a protocol bump.

code.description: Machine detail where one exists, such as a process exit status.

message.description: One line, already the most useful line rather than the first one.

detail.description: The rest, unbounded and unsummarized. Consumers decide how much to show.

remedy.description: What to do next, when that is knowable.
